validation_cohesion_checking.overview: Final cohesion and contradiction checks for the governance-sync mode. Use this to confirm the mode remains internally consistent and synchronized with its supporting files.

principle.name: comprehensive_review
principle.description: Review the mode as a whole, not as isolated fragments.

checklist.item: Read all existing XML guidance files in the mode directory.
Compare terminology across files for consistency.
Check that examples match the stated rules and recovery behavior.
Verify that the mode role and permissions still align with the instructions.

principle.name: contradiction_detection
principle.description: Actively look for overlaps or conflicts between files.

contradiction.resolution: Keep the clearest single source and trim the duplicate wording elsewhere.
Update the mode permissions or adjust the instruction if the scope no longer matches.
Ensure recovery rules are present in both the workflow and the error-handling guidance.

steps.step: Identify the exact file or files that need to change.
Check whether the request is a preservation edit or a recovery edit.
Confirm the smallest safe change set.

category.name: structural_validation
category.check: The numbered mode files exist in the expected order.
The mode slug appears exactly once in .roomodes.

category.name: content_validation
category.check: The roleDefinition matches the actual scope of the mode.
The whenToUse text clearly differentiates this mode from others.
The examples demonstrate the intended behavior without runtime detail.
The recovery guidance matches the preserve-first policy.

category.name: integration_validation
category.check: Handoff points to other modes are explicit.

flag.description: The mode references permissions not included in its groups.
flag.action: Align the permissions or remove the unsupported instruction.

flag.description: The supporting files introduce conflicting workflows.
flag.action: Consolidate to one source of truth and update the others to match.

flag.description: Examples drift away from the mode's stated purpose.
flag.action: Revise the example to match the current mode intent.
